title: Kissinger studied under Thomas Schelling, who later tried an intervention

tellings.quote: he actually studied at at Harvard under Tom shelling

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions that the American statesman Henry Kissinger studied at Harvard under Thomas Schelling, a scholar of strategy. Michels raises the connection as part of a story about Schelling later trying some kind of intervention with Kissinger, though the telling leaves the details vague.
